repos.name: movie-recommender
repos.description: A content-based movie recommender built with Python. Give it a movie title and it returns the 5 most similar movies from the TMDB 5000 dataset

repos.name: mnist-digit-classifier
repos.description: Handwritten digit classification on MNIST: preprocessing (normalization, PCA, augmentation) and comparison of Logistic Regression, KNN, Random Forest and SVM.

repos.name: MyAirportApp
repos.description: Developed a mobile application for flight management, featuring an admin panel for CRUD operations and a user space for registration, login and booking. The backend is built in Java, the UI designed in XML, and the data stored in a SQLite database.

repos.name: BaniolaForCarRental
repos.description: Web application to manage car rentals. It allows customers to browse available cars, make reservations, and manage bookings, while admins can refuse or confirm those reservations.

repos.name: ContactsApp
repos.description: Simple Android contacts app, add, edit, delete, all stored locally with SQLite
